Daily Devotional

November 12

27 And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb's book of life. (Revelation 21:27 KJV)

This is speaking of the New Jerusalem that comes down from heaven and is on the New Earth (Revelation 21:2), as the old earth has been destroyed by fire, and everything on it is gone (2 Peter 3:12). The New Jerusalem will be a Holy City, and no corruption will ever be allowed into it. God and Jesus will dwell there with all the saints whose names are in the book of life. WOW! That is so awesome that we will have a brand new earth and city to live in forever, with the Father and Son. The New Earth will have animals and everything, and the corruption will all be gone, and the lion will lay with the lamb, and all the killing for food will disappear. What a wonderful world it will be, when our Father God (Revelation 21:3), and Jesus, will live right there with us children of His.

Just think of the fact that there will be no devil, death, germs, disease, sickness, pain and such things (Revelation 21:4), and everything will be perfect. God meant for the present earth to be that way, and wanted us to be that way, but we have messed it up. God is so good; to give us the opportunity to start over with a new world and He will be right there to live in it with us. With Jesus as the King of the world, we know that it will last forever in an incorruptible state, and we won’t have to worry about death, sickness or pain ever again. This truly will be heaven on earth, and will last for eternity. Without corruption of any kind, there will be no deterioration, and everything will stay in perfection forever. Thank you Father for the Grace given us, so that we can know you again (John 17:3), and look forward to living with you forever. Thank you Jesus!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
